evidence: Applied the skill's Verify procedure (quality-checks.md ### 5): case-insensitive grep of task/instruction.md and both environment/instructions/*.md for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|probe|gate|verif|grader|oracle|scored|polish|visual|functional|mcp|harbor returned zero matches. A second grep for the criterion-id prefix 'hro_'/'hro-', probe, sentinel, judge, rubric, grader, test across instruction.md, the notes and environment/assets/seed_data.json returned only hireops_rules.md:172 where 'test' is a substring of 'latest' ('at the latest on the next action that needs the server') - not a leak. No criterion id (hro_job_open, hro_bulk_move, hro_drafts, ... from tests/scored/functional/judge.toml and gate ids hro_gate_render/hro_gate_shared), dimension name (functional/polish/visual/render/constraints), weight (0.6/0.2/0.5 etc.), test path (/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, $APP_RESTART_HELPER), judge model or tool (claude-code, playwright-mcp) appears in the brief or notes. Paths the brief does name (/instructions/hireops_rules.md, /instructions/integration.md, /assets/seed_data.json, /app, /app/app.db, GET /api/health) are agent-facing build inputs/runtime contract, not grader paths. Verbatim-overlap check: 10-token shingle comparison between the public brief+notes and all judge.toml/prompt.md text found exactly one shared run, 'arrive at the bottom of that stage in board order' (hireops_rules.md:90 vs the bulk-move criterion) - a criterion restating a public requirement, which is the intended direction, not a criterion or probe leaking into the prompt. Shared account emails and password Hireops!2026 between instruction.md:17 and tests/app_context.md:8-19 are profile-expected credentials (SKILL.md known false positives), not grader sentinels. Template instruction.md is only a CHANGE_ME placeholder, so there is no template-controlled leak to inherit. Attempted counterexamples: (a) a weak app that could pass because of a leak - none possible from this row, since no probe literal, criterion bar or judge procedure is disclosed that an app could special-case; (b) a conforming app that could fail because of this row - none; the brief contains no grader-specific wording an honest build would be penalised for not matching. Source-only row; no runtime measurement is required for it.
